scope: STREAMING MULTI-CSV VALIDATION & TEST SUITE VERIFICATION

leakage_status_definitions.PASS: All checks verified without data leakage or temporal inversion
leakage_status_definitions.PASS_PARTIAL: Core checks passed (observation identity, temporal order, label exclusion), but secondary checks (scaler or window boundary) are NOT_VERIFIED due to missing optional inputs
leakage_status_definitions.FAIL: Critical data leakage, temporal inversion, or label leakage detected
leakage_status_definitions.NOT_VERIFIED: Empty DataFrame or check omitted due to lack of required context

multi_csv_streaming_audit.method: 50,000 rows streamed per CSV before shared-tail range; 100 rows TXT normal run
